title: Global Large Model Usage Ranking Undergoes Major Changes: Chinese Technology Companies Directly Take the Top Five!

content_html:
Recently, the global multi-model aggregation platform OpenRouter released the latest weekly AI model usage data. The top five models on the list, without exception, were all developed by Chinese companies. This impressive achievement marks that domestic large models are beginning to gain a leading advantage in the global market.

In this highly anticipated list, the top spot was taken by Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5, which achieved an astonishing 10.5 trillion Tokens in weekly usage, representing a 12% increase compared to the previous week. The second and fifth positions were both claimed by DeepSeek. By combining two models, DeepSeek effectively covers different application needs of developers. The flagship Pro version has performance that can directly compete with top overseas closed-source models, especially in code writing and complex intelligent agent tasks.

Notably, these top products generally demonstrate "instant peak" explosive power, rapidly climbing to the top of the list shortly after their launch. The third place was occupied by Tencent HuanYuan 3, which showed strong growth momentum. It was officially open-sourced only on July 6th, and its weekly growth rate exceeded 999%, becoming the most surprising rising star on the entire list.

content_html_zh:
近日，全球多模型聚合平台OpenRouter发布了最新的每周AI模型使用数据。 榜单前五名的车型无一例外都是中国企业研发的。 这一骄人成绩标志着国产大型车型开始在全球市场取得领先优势。

在这份万众瞩目的榜单中，小米MiMo-V2.5占据了榜首，其周使用量达到了惊人的10.5万亿枚Token，较前一周增长了12%。 第二名和第五名均由 DeepSeek 夺得。 通过结合两种模型，DeepSeek有效覆盖了开发者的不同应用需求。 旗舰Pro版本具有可以直接与海外顶级闭源模型竞争的性能，尤其是在代码编写和复杂的智能代理任务方面。

值得注意的是，这些顶级产品普遍展现出“瞬间巅峰”的爆发力，上市后不久就迅速登上榜单榜首。 第三名是腾讯欢源3，表现出强劲的增长势头。 7月6日才正式开源，周增长率超过999%，成为整个榜单上最令人惊讶的后起之秀。
